title: Expired / canceled-past users get a generic landing message and cannot open Account
persona: Trial user, day 7 (QA-PAYWALL, signed webhooks + forged sl_session cookie)
expected: Landing explains why (trial ended / membership canceled / payment failed) and the user can still reach Account/billing to resubscribe.
actual: Same generic "couldn't find an active membership" text for every reason; /account is behind requirePaid so it redirects too, so the "Expired" / "Canceled" labels in statusLabel are unreachable for the person they describe.
